hero.title: PUNCH UI
hero.description: Build bold Neobrutalist interfaces faster. Pull ready-to-use shadcn/ui components, customize themes live, and ship seamlessly in Next.js or React.

showcase.title: Live Production-Ready Showcase
showcase.description: Switch color presets, custom tokens, border radius, or Dark Mode in the Theme Customizer above — every real-world card below updates in real time.

cta.title: Ready to Build Your Neobrutalist Dashboard?
cta.description: Follow the 4-step setup guide in Docs, then pull only the components you need directly through the shadcn Custom Registry CLI.

story.title: Built for Interfaces That Refuse to Blend In
story.lead: Punch UI was born out of fatigue with look-alike, overly soft, blurry web apps. It pairs the unapologetic clarity of Neobrutalism (2px borders, hard offset shadows, high-contrast color) with the production ergonomics of shadcn/ui and Radix UI.

pillars.title: Bold & Tactile
pillars.description: Zero blurry gradients or timid shadows. Every button, input, and card delivers crisp mechanical press feedback and clear focus states.

pillars.title: Take Only What You Need
pillars.description: Install individual components via the shadcn CLI directly into your repo — zero bloated bundles and easy to modify.

pillars.title: Live Theme Engine
pillars.description: Powered by pure CSS variables supporting 6 presets, a live Custom Color Builder, dynamic radius, and instant Light & Dark mode.

kpi.label: Total Revenue (KPI Preview)
kpi.description: Uses JetBrains Mono font for maximum numeric legibility.
